import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# --- Color scheme: editorial, consistent across all panels ---
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#C44E52',  # muted red
    'NCD': '#4C72B0',           # steel blue
    'Injury': '#CCB974',        # muted gold
}
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2D2D2D'
GRID_COLOR = '#E0E0E0'
SUBTLE_TEXT = '#777777'
ACCENT_DARK = '#333333'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'axes.edgecolor': GRID_COLOR,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 26))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FFFFFF')

# Main title
fig.text(0.5, 0.975, 'The Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 vs 2024',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=26, fontweight='bold', color=ACCENT_DARK)
fig.text(0.5, 0.962, 'Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) by cause, category, and World Bank income group',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=14, color=SUBTLE_TEXT)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, figure=fig,
                       top=0.94, bottom=0.04, left=0.06, right=0.96,
                       hspace=0.32, wspace=0.30,
                       height_ratios=[1.15, 0.9, 0.9])

# =========================================================================
# PANEL A: Slope/bump chart — Top 10 DALY causes rank change 1990 → 2024
# =========================================================================
ax_bump = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_bump.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

causes_1990 = {r['cause']: r for r in data['top10_daly_causes']['data'] if r['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {r['cause']: r for r in data['top10_daly_causes']['data'] if r['year'] == 2024}

all_causes = sorted(set(list(causes_1990.keys()) + list(causes_2024.keys())))

# Positions: x=0 for 1990, x=1 for 2024
# y = rank (inverted so rank 1 is at top)
max_rank = 14  # leave room for causes that dropped off

def get_rank_pos(rank):
    return -rank  # negative so rank 1 is highest

ax_bump.set_xlim(-0.35, 1.35)
ax_bump.set_ylim(-max_rank - 0.5, -0.3)

# Draw connections
for cause in all_causes:
    r90 = causes_1990.get(cause)
    r24 = causes_2024.get(cause)

    cat = r90['category'] if r90 else r24['category']
    color = COLORS[cat]

    if r90 and r24:
        y1 = get_rank_pos(r90['rank'])
        y2 = get_rank_pos(r24['rank'])
        rank_change = abs(r90['rank'] - r24['rank'])
        lw = 2.5 + rank_change * 0.5
        alpha = 0.5 + min(rank_change * 0.08, 0.4)
        ax_bump.plot([0, 1], [y1, y2], color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=2, solid_capstyle='round')
        # Left dot + label
        ax_bump.scatter(0, y1, s=90, color=color, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1)
        ax_bump.text(-0.03, y1, f'{r90["rank"]}. {cause}  ({r90["dalys_millions"]:.0f}M)',
                     ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=color, fontweight='bold')
        # Right dot + label
        ax_bump.scatter(1, y2, s=90, color=color, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1)
        ax_bump.text(1.03, y2, f'{r24["rank"]}. {cause}  ({r24["dalys_millions"]:.0f}M)',
                     ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=color, fontweight='bold')
    elif r90 and not r24:
        y1 = get_rank_pos(r90['rank'])
        exit_y = get_rank_pos(12)
        ax_bump.plot([0, 0.85], [y1, exit_y], color=color, linewidth=2, alpha=0.3, zorder=1,
                     linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round')
        ax_bump.scatter(0, y1, s=90, color=color, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1)
        ax_bump.text(-0.03, y1, f'{r90["rank"]}. {cause}  ({r90["dalys_millions"]:.0f}M)',
                     ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=color, fontweight='bold')
        ax_bump.text(0.88, exit_y, f'Dropped out ▸', ha='left', va='center',
                     fontsize=8, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, fontstyle='italic')
    elif not r90 and r24:
        y2 = get_rank_pos(r24['rank'])
        entry_y = get_rank_pos(12)
        ax_bump.plot([0.15, 1], [entry_y, y2], color=color, linewidth=2, alpha=0.3, zorder=1,
                     linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round')
        ax_bump.scatter(1, y2, s=90, color=color, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1)
        ax_bump.text(1.03, y2, f'{r24["rank"]}. {cause}  ({r24["dalys_millions"]:.0f}M)',
                     ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=color, fontweight='bold')
        ax_bump.text(0.12, entry_y, f'◂ New entry', ha='right', va='center',
                     fontsize=8, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, fontstyle='italic')

# Year labels at top
ax_bump.text(0, -0.5, '1990', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=ACCENT_DARK)
ax_bump.text(1, -0.5, '2024', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=ACCENT_DARK)

# Vertical guide lines
ax_bump.axvline(0, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=1, zorder=0)
ax_bump.axvline(1, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=1, zorder=0)

ax_bump.set_title('A. Top 10 Global DALY Causes — Rank Changes',
                   fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=14, color=ACCENT_DARK)
ax_bump.axis('off')

# =========================================================================
# PANEL B: Global Category Totals — paired bar chart (1990 vs 2024)
# =========================================================================
ax_totals = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

categories_order = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
totals_1990 = {r['category']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in data['global_category_totals']['data'] if r['year'] == 1990}
totals_2024 = {r['category']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in data['global_category_totals']['data'] if r['year'] == 2024}

x = np.arange(len(categories_order))
width = 0.32

bars_90 = ax_totals.bar(x - width/2, [totals_1990[c] for c in categories_order], width,
                         color=[COLORS[c] for c in categories_order], alpha=0.55,
                         edgecolor=[COLORS[c] for c in categories_order], linewidth=1.5,
                         label='1990', hatch='///')
bars_24 = ax_totals.bar(x + width/2, [totals_2024[c] for c in categories_order], width,
                         color=[COLORS[c] for c in categories_order], alpha=1.0,
                         edgecolor=[COLORS[c] for c in categories_order], linewidth=1.5,
                         label='2024')

for bar, cat in zip(bars_90, categories_order):
    val = totals_1990[cat]
    ax_totals.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 15,
                   f'{val:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
for bar, cat in zip(bars_24, categories_order):
    val = totals_2024[cat]
    ax_totals.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 15,
                   f'{val:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9.5, color=ACCENT_DARK, fontweight='bold')

ax_totals.set_xticks(x)
ax_totals.set_xticklabels(categories_order, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax_totals.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)', fontsize=11)
ax_totals.set_title('B. Global DALYs by Category',
                     fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10, color=ACCENT_DARK)
ax_totals.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_totals.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_totals.set_ylim(0, 1700)
ax_totals.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax_totals.set_axisbelow(True)

# Custom legend for 1990 vs 2024
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor='#999999', alpha=0.55, edgecolor='#999999', linewidth=1.5, hatch='///', label='1990'),
    Patch(facecolor='#999999', alpha=1.0, edgecolor='#999999', linewidth=1.5, label='2024'),
]
ax_totals.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=10, frameon=True,
                 facecolor='white', edgecolor=GRID_COLOR)

# Add change annotations
for i, cat in enumerate(categories_order):
    v90 = totals_1990[cat]
    v24 = totals_2024[cat]
    pct_change = ((v24 - v90) / v90) * 100
    sign = '+' if pct_change > 0 else ''
    mid_y = max(v90, v24) + 70
    ax_totals.annotate(f'{sign}{pct_change:.0f}%',
                       xy=(i, mid_y), ha='center', va='bottom',
                       fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
                       color=COLORS['NCD'] if pct_change > 0 else COLORS['Communicable'])

# =========================================================================
# PANEL C: Stacked bar — DALY share by income group, 1990
# =========================================================================
income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle\nincome', 'Upper-middle\nincome', 'High income']
income_groups_raw = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']

income_data_1990 = {r['income_group']: r for r in data['daly_by_income_group']['data'] if r['year'] == 1990}
income_data_2024 = {r['income_group']: r for r in data['daly_by_income_group']['data'] if r['year'] == 2024}

def draw_stacked_bar(ax, income_data, year_label, panel_letter):
    y_pos = np.arange(len(income_groups_raw))

    comm_vals = [income_data[ig]['communicable_pct'] for ig in income_groups_raw]
    ncd_vals = [income_data[ig]['ncd_pct'] for ig in income_groups_raw]
    inj_vals = [income_data[ig]['injury_pct'] for ig in income_groups_raw]

    bars_c = ax.barh(y_pos, comm_vals, height=0.6, color=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    bars_n = ax.barh(y_pos, ncd_vals, height=0.6, left=comm_vals, color=COLORS['NCD'], label='NCD', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    bars_i = ax.barh(y_pos, inj_vals, height=0.6, left=[c+n for c,n in zip(comm_vals, ncd_vals)],
                     color=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injury', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Add percentage labels inside bars (only if segment is wide enough)
    for i in range(len(income_groups_raw)):
        # Communicable
        if comm_vals[i] > 12:
            ax.text(comm_vals[i]/2, y_pos[i], f'{comm_vals[i]:.1f}%',
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')
        # NCD
        if ncd_vals[i] > 12:
            ax.text(comm_vals[i] + ncd_vals[i]/2, y_pos[i], f'{ncd_vals[i]:.1f}%',
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')
        # Injury
        if inj_vals[i] > 12:
            ax.text(comm_vals[i] + ncd_vals[i] + inj_vals[i]/2, y_pos[i], f'{inj_vals[i]:.1f}%',
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white')

    ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels(income_groups, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_xlabel('Share of total DALYs (%)', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 105)
    ax.set_title(f'{panel_letter}. DALY Composition by Income Group — {year_label}',
                 fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10, color=ACCENT_DARK)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.xaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.invert_yaxis()

ax_inc90 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
draw_stacked_bar(ax_inc90, income_data_1990, '1990', 'C')

ax_inc24 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
draw_stacked_bar(ax_inc24, income_data_2024, '2024', 'D')

# =========================================================================
# PANEL E (top-right of row 1): Communicable vs NCD share shift — Global
# =========================================================================
ax_shift = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# Global percentage shares
total_1990 = sum(totals_1990.values())
total_2024 = sum(totals_2024.values())

shares_1990 = {c: totals_1990[c]/total_1990*100 for c in categories_order}
shares_2024 = {c: totals_2024[c]/total_2024*100 for c in categories_order}

# Donut charts side by side
def draw_donut(ax, shares, year, cx, radius=0.35):
    vals = [shares[c] for c in categories_order]
    colors = [COLORS[c] for c in categories_order]
    wedges, _ = ax.pie(vals, colors=colors, startangle=90, counterclock=False,
                        center=(cx, 0.5), radius=radius,
                        wedgeprops=dict(width=0.13, edgecolor='white', linewidth=2))
    ax.text(cx, 0.5, f'{year}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=ACCENT_DARK)

    # Labels around
    angle_start = 90
    for i, cat in enumerate(categories_order):
        angle_span = vals[i] / 100 * 360
        mid_angle = angle_start - angle_span / 2
        angle_start -= angle_span
        rad = np.deg2rad(mid_angle)
        lx = cx + (radius + 0.09) * np.cos(rad)
        ly = 0.5 + (radius + 0.09) * np.sin(rad)
        ax.text(lx, ly, f'{vals[i]:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS[cat])

ax_shift.set_xlim(-0.15, 1.15)
ax_shift.set_ylim(-0.1, 1.1)
ax_shift.set_aspect('equal')
draw_donut(ax_shift, shares_1990, '1990', 0.22)
draw_donut(ax_shift, shares_2024, '2024', 0.78)

# Arrow between donuts
ax_shift.annotate('', xy=(0.58, 0.5), xytext=(0.42, 0.5),
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=SUBTLE_TEXT, lw=2))

ax_shift.set_title('E. Global DALY Share Shift',
                    fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10, color=ACCENT_DARK)
ax_shift.axis('off')

# =========================================================================
# Shared legend at bottom
# =========================================================================
legend_patches = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable (incl. maternal, neonatal, nutritional)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['NCD'], label='Non-communicable diseases (NCDs)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injuries'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='lower center', ncol=3, fontsize=12,
           frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False,
           edgecolor=GRID_COLOR, facecolor='white',
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.005))

# Source note
fig.text(0.06, 0.012, 'Source: Global Burden of Disease study estimates (GBD-style methodology). 2024 figures are projected estimates.',
         ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, fontstyle='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='#FFFFFF', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

        ly = 0.5 + (radius + 0.09) * np.sin(rad)
        ax.text(lx, ly, f'{vals[i]:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS[cat])
